Protect Your Body

Oxford Read and Discover · Level 2 · Your Body · Pages 18–19

🔒 New Words 1 · Listen & Fill 2 · Write 3 · Present 4 · Mind Map

★ New Words

🔒 This part is for the teacher.

Teach these words before the listening task. Press 🔊 to hear the word (American English). Show the picture, read the meaning, then read the example.

food

noun

What you eat.

“Eat food that’s good for you.”

strong

adjective

Having a lot of power.

“Good food makes you strong.”

lose

verb

To have less of something.

“You lose water when you sweat.”

drink

verb

To take water or milk into your mouth.

“Drink water every day.”

doctor

noun

A person who helps sick people.

“Go to the doctor when you get sick.”

dentist

noun

A doctor for your teeth.

“Go to the dentist every year.”

exercise

noun

Moving your body to be healthy, like running.

“Do exercise every day.”

happy

adjective

Feeling good. 😊

“Exercise makes you happy.”

tired

adjective

When you need to sleep or rest.

“It’s good to sleep when you are tired.”

important

adjective

Very, very needed.

“It’s important to protect your body.”

2 Write a Summary

Write about how to protect your body in your own words. Write 15 words or more. Then you can see my example.

💡 Answer these questions

  1. What does good food do?
  2. When do you lose water?
  3. What do you drink every day?
  4. When do you go to the doctor?
  5. When do you go to the dentist?
  6. What makes you happy?

✏️ Start like this

  • Good food helps …
  • I lose water when …
  • I drink …
  • I go to the doctor when …
  • I go to the dentist …
  • Exercise makes me …
0 / 15 words

⭐ Example Summary

I eat food that’s good for me. Good food helps my bones to grow, makes me strong, and stops me getting sick. I lose water when I go to the toilet and when I sweat, so I drink water every day. I go to the doctor when I get sick and to the dentist every year. I do exercise every day because it makes me happy. I sleep when I am tired.

3 Presentation Script

Read the script. Practise it. Then present to your class!

Hello!Start

Good morning, everyone! My name is ________. Today I want to talk about how to protect our body.

Here are six ways to keep our body safe and strong!

👉 Show six fingers.
Way 1Good food

Number one: eat food that’s good for you. Good food helps our bones to grow. It makes us strong, and it stops us getting sick.

👉 Show the food picture. Rub your tummy: “Yum!”
Way 2Water

Number two: drink water. There’s lots of water in our body. We lose water when we go to the toilet and when we sweat. So we drink water every day!

👉 Pretend to drink a glass of water.
Way 3Doctor · Dentist

Number three: go to the doctor when you get sick. Number four: go to the dentist every year.

👉 Show three fingers, then four fingers.
Way 4Exercise

Number five: do exercise every day. It’s good for us, and it makes us happy!

👉 Jump or run on the spot. Smile!
Way 5Sleep

Number six: sleep when you are tired.

Question for you: Which way do you like best? (Wait for answers.)

👉 Pretend to sleep. Then ask the class.
The EndFinish

Remember: it’s important to protect our body!

Thank you for listening! Do you have any questions?

👉 Smile and say “Thank you!”

🌟 Presentation Tips

  • Speak slowly and loudly.
  • Look at your friends, not only at the paper.
  • Point to the pictures when you talk.
  • Smile! 😊
